name: Training Plane
dimensions: Height 55 mm; Width 104 mm; Depth 85 mm
summary: This plane is lithographed tinplate with a clockwork mechanism housed inside the body. When wound up the plane moves on two centre wheels connected to the mechanism and a balancing wheel at the back. At the same time, a metal lever under the plane lowers, lifts it off the ground and somersaults it.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
